topic: 1950 election and monetary committee provenance conflicts

findings.details: 1950-06-03 Gyeonghyang article narrative 130, its own table 128, NIKH later chronology 126; cannot collapse these into a single count without official return.
June 2 Seoul Sinmun reports one member list; Bank of Korea institutional archive places first board meeting June 5 and operating start June 12. Original appointment roster needed.

FRUS telegram 614 reports 34 senior police changes (five resignations, 29 transfers) and Rhee restrictions on further dismissals; June 2 Korean press transcribes Rhee's explanation of election non-interference. The motive and actual order books remain unverified.
